question.prompt: To find out how many of a school's 1200 students enjoy reading, 100 students are randomly selected, and 45 of them enjoy reading. Estimate approximately how many students in the school enjoy reading. (Enter an integer.)

solutions.explanation: 45% of the sample enjoy reading, so the estimated number for the whole school is approximately \(1200\times45\%=540\) students.
solutions.title: Apply the sample percentage
